overview: The Medford Conservation Commission welcomed a new member and reviewed several wetland permitting applications and compliance requests. The commission approved a driveway replacement at 69 South Street, a 40B residential development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway, two certificates of compliance, and an amended order of conditions for a bicycle path extension.

items.title: Welcome New Commission Member
items.summary: The commission formally welcomed new member Caroline to the Conservation Commission.

items.title: RDA - 69 South Street Driveway Replacement
items.summary: Approved a negative determination of applicability with conditions regarding tree protection and erosion control for driveway replacement and paver installation at 69 South Street.

items.title: Notice of Intent - 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Approved an order of conditions for a 40B residential redevelopment project at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway, subject to additional long-term pollution prevention and stormwater inspection details.

items.title: Certificates of Compliance - 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway and Commercial Street Extension
items.summary: Approved certificates of compliance for prior completed work at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway and the 1992 Commercial Street extension project.

items.title: Amended Notice of Intent - Bicycle Path Extension
items.summary: Approved an amended order of conditions allowing Eversource and DCR to construct a bicycle path extension and raised crosswalks near the Medford Community Gardens.
